description: Aéroports et aérodromes de Bretagne/Loire Atlantique 2010 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geobretagne.fr. Location of airport infrastructure in Brittany and Loire-Atlantique. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Airports and airfields of Brittany/Loire Atlantique 2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bretagne, aerodromes, données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
